_note: High-impedance earphone, the crystal-set classic. 2-terminal: a, b. Engine (bw-board earphone): type magnetic (2 kohm coil, 0.1 H) or crystal (piezo element: capacitance with a high leak resistance, no DC path, so a crystal set needs a resistor across it). Sound from the coil current like the speaker: buzzerTone() reports hz, on, level, amps. Drawn as the earpiece on its two-wire lead.
